text.p: Iraq on Friday called for a "Palestinian revolution" in the West Bank and Gaza to liberate Arabs from Israeli occupation.

"The real solution is the solution that ignites a Palestinian revolution in the soul, mind and consciousness of every honest and sincere believer until the liberation of Palestine," said an official statement carried by state television.
The statement also urged Arab countries to mend fences with Baghdad to bring about unified Arab action against Israel and its allies.
It blamed the United States and Israel for the eruption of clashes in the West Bank and Gaza Strip in which 44 Palestinians and 11 Israelis have been killed since Wednesday.
